meta.title: Pip Drops the Ball
meta.textType: story: a cartoon story with key words

paragraphs: On Sunday morning, Tom and Lily walked along the river with Pip. Pip carried his red ball in his mouth. The sun was bright, and the water was blue. "Let's play catch with Pip," said Tom. "That's a good idea!" said Lily. "But can he catch?" "Let's see," said Tom. He threw the ball, and Pip ran after it. Pip caught it, but then he dropped it. He played this game badly, but he was very happy.

Tom threw the ball again and again. Pip jumped and ran, but he dropped it every time. "This is the worst game of the day!" said Tom. Then Pip dropped the ball near the river. It rolled down the grass and into the water. The water carried it down the river. Pip looked at Lily, and he was sad. "Oh, Pip!" said Lily. "Where is the ball going?"

The ball stopped by some big rocks in the water. Sam stood on the grass with a long net. "What's the matter?" asked Sam. "Pip dropped his ball in the river," said Lily. "I have an idea," said Sam. He put his net into the water and caught the ball. Tom and Lily clapped their hands. Sam gave the ball to Pip. Pip jumped up and down. Now Pip held it well, and he did not drop it. They all walked along the river, and Pip was very happy.
text.summary: Tom and Lily teach Pip to catch a ball by the river. Pip drops the ball into the water, and Sam gets it back with his net.
